ShortDescription.Value: Plan journeys between buildings or follow a citizen, with optimized rendering and player-selected transit colours.

Publish.LongDescription:
Just like in real life, when you use public transport in 2026, you typically use a website or an app to plan your journey. In Denmark, we use Rejseplanen.dk (web app). I wanted to create a UI experience that looks and feels similar to this.
The reason I wanted to create this tool was to be able to see what a journey from A to B from a citizens point of view.
I developed this mod using ChatGPT to help me reverse-engineer how the game's pathfinding system works.
Great news: During my reverse-engineering journey, I discovered that citizens actually do this planning themselves, including planning interchanges! So you can actually click on a citizen and see their full journey.
Version 1.2.0 optimizes selection and route rendering and follows the player's transit line colours.
UVM compatible: subscribe to Unified Verified Mods and open Options > Unified Verified Mods to compare this package with signed build evidence at https://vezit.net. The public GitHub repository includes the exact build recipe. A matching build is not a security audit.
Publish.ChangeLog:
Performance optimized and UVM compatible.
- Uses local spatial searches for citizen/building selection instead of scanning all positioned objects. - Caches route geometry and draws it through the native overlay renderer with a Burst job. - Reduces allocations and repeated path processing during citizen progress updates. - Transit paths, stop markers and journey cards use the player's saved line colours. - Includes a reproducible UVM build recipe covering the C# DLL, native Burst library and UI assets. - Signed build evidence can be inspected at vezit.net with Unified Verified Mods.
Performance changes reduce avoidable work; no specific FPS improvement is claimed.
